text:
Taylor H: PR ready but holding for architecture review — attaching RFC and PR. Main change: traffic-split + fallback mapping to route to cheaper quantized variants when load spikes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/9864 RFC: https://r.redwood.ai/rfcs/arch-quant-routing-2025
Megan L: @Taylor H can you paste the SLO delta here? need to include it in the RFC or PR body for arch review.
Taylor H: short summary: ~12ms p95 increase under sustained burst in our synthetic benchmark, steady-state no change. rollout plan in RFC reduces impact with 2% canary and progressive ramp. adding the SLO table now.
Chris P: cc @arch-bot — requesting architecture eyes. Also small nit I noticed in the branch: suggest renaming param `fallback_map` -> `fallback_policy` for clarity.
arch-bot: Automated check: RFC link missing section `Rollout & SLO` OR PR body not referencing RFC section. Merge blocked until PR body includes RFC anchor and SLO summary.
Taylor H: updated PR body, added a `Rollout & SLO` section and pasted the benchmark table. PR link updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/9864 (edited)
Ryan S: what's the preferred merge window? I'm on-call Wed/Thu afternoon, would prefer Tue midday if that works.
Megan L: I can take the architecture review today. ping me when PR is updated (looking now).
Chris P: quick heads-up: CI matrix failing on python3.10 in the branch, I'll push a tiny fix to the branch in ~5m.
Taylor H: thanks — pushed the fix and rebased onto main. running CI again.
arch-bot: Arch review requested from: Megan L. Please respond within 48 hours or add a documented degraded fallback in PR to satisfy safety gating.
Megan L: left two small comments on the RFC (clarify traffic-split labels, add an example of fallback route). APPROVED the architecture approach. Recommended rollout: canary 2% for 24h -> 10% for 6h -> full if metrics stable. :white_check_mark:
Taylor H: great, will update the rollout config and squash. @Ryan S can we plan merge for Tue 12:00 UTC? I'll monitor the canary.
Ryan S: Works for me — I'll add the slot to the release calendar and be available for the midday window.
Taylor H: :thumbsup: merging after CI passes and canary config is added. will post back when merged and canary started.
